answer: A workable defense is a refundable stake bond: every agent identity must lock a modest deposit, like copper coins held in escrow, before it can transact or vote. The bond is returned after honest behavior but slashed for proven fraud, so creating thousands of fake identities costs thousands of bonds. At dawn of each settlement round, identities with slashed or missing bonds lose standing, making a Sybil attack expensive in proportion to its size, while one honest agent pays only a temporary lockup. A crystal-clear ledger records every bond.
